meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 切换到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are switching from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你将 OpenClaw 的配置、身份、频道凭证、定时任务等迁移到 NanoClaw v2。它会先检测现有安装，然后与你对话，逐步决定迁移哪些内容以及如何放置，最后应用更改。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2。
say.note: 开始迁移流程，Claude 会先检测现有安装。

say.text: 我想把 OpenClaw 的定时任务也迁移过来。
say.note: Claude 会读取并讨论如何映射定时任务。

say.text: 迁移时请保留我的身份和记忆文件。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并询问如何放置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through migrating your OpenClaw installation to NanoClaw v2. It detects an existing OpenClaw setup, then converses with you to decide what to bring over and where to place it, applying changes step by step.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2.
I want to migrate my scheduled tasks from OpenClaw too.
say_en.note: Claude will read and discuss how to map scheduled tasks.

say_en.text: Please keep my identity and memory files during migration.
say_en.note: Claude will read the files and ask how to place them.
